purpose: Implement ADR-4148 as amended by ADR-4151: the verifier hand produces a Test-stage verify report before merge and Finalise ingests it on the PR branch before the merge to write verified deterministically, with provenance checks and the bundle --next backstop.
responsibilities: src/verify/cli/run.js: --hand <name> stamps the hand and writes a VerifyReport v1 (headSha from git rev-parse HEAD, target, mode, hand, verifierId) to rcf/verify-reports/<fbs-id>/<headSha12>.json, with --fbs naming exactly one build spec; --out is refused with --hand.

src/finalise/ingest.js: loadVerifyReport and checkReportProvenance (the report committed at HEAD with the bytes on disk, ancestry or tree equality against HEAD, a loopback target accepted only with engine, port and servedSha equal to headSha, hand separation, age window) as pure functions over git lookups.

src/cli/finalise.js: the default path reads the report and spawns nothing; --mode agentScreenshotCritique and --mode deterministic leave Finalise (they belong to rcf verify run); every refusal names its reason and exit code.
src/cli/build.js: bundle --next refuses while a merged spec inside the backstop window is complete and not verified; --allow-unverified "<reason>" proceeds and records the override.
internalStructure: Report schema and provenance checks are rcf-lite-local (no rcf-schemas change): the report lives in a walker-invisible directory like rcf/discovery/. Finalise becomes read report, check, write; the only side effect is the FBS executionStatus write through updateDocument with allowVerifiedOverride.

interfaces.name: rcf verify run (Test stage)
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf verify run --url <preview-or-version-url> --fbs <fbs-id> --mode <deterministic|agentScreenshotCritique> --hand verifier --verifier-id <text> [--engine <name> --served-sha <sha>] [--parity-env <env>]
Writes a VerifyReport v1 to rcf/verify-reports/<fbs-id>/<headSha12>.json (--out is refused with --hand) and prints "verify report: <path> <verdict> <verified>/<total>". A URL target records target.engine (--engine), target.port (the URL port, or 80 / 443 by scheme) and target.servedSha (--served-sha) when given; a loopback --url with --hand needs --engine and --served-sha (exit 2 naming the missing flag), and a --served-sha that is not the full sha of the committed HEAD exits 4 (ADR-4151, AC-19005-5). Exit 0 report written and verdict PASS, 4 report written and verdict not PASS or a refusal, 2 usage, 1 IO.

interfaces.name: rcf build finalise
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> [--report <path>] [--max-report-age <days>]
Ingests the Test-stage verify report for the FBS and writes executionStatus verified when every precondition and provenance check holds, on any branch: it runs on the PR branch at the PR head before the merge and the merge carries verified; a re-run on the default branch after a merge commit confirms with no write (ADR-4151). --ci-run names a green CI run on the PR head the report names (on the confirm, the merged head run); it is recorded on the verified line only and never fetched. --allow-pre-merge is a no-op that prints one deprecation line. Spawns no verify subprocess and no agent CLI; its only child processes are git lookups. Exit 0 promoted or confirmed, 4 refused (ci evidence missing, not complete, report missing, report not committed at HEAD or differing from its committed bytes, report head not contained in HEAD, loopback target naming no target.engine, target.port or target.servedSha, target.servedSha not the report head, verifier hand equals builder hand, report too old, verdict not PASS or not ship authority, a blocking per-AC verdict), 3 report or tree fails validation or missing Code Nodes, 2 usage.

interfaces.name: rcf build bundle --next (backstop)
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf build bundle --next [--allow-unverified "<reason>"]
Refuses exit 4 with "backstop: <n> merged spec(s) complete and not verified: <ids>" while any FBS inside the adopted backstop window is complete and not verified. --allow-unverified with a non-empty reason proceeds and appends { reason, by, at, unverifiedFbsIds } to backstop.overrides in rcf/define/backstop.json.

interfaces.name: rcf build backstop adopt
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf build backstop adopt --from <fbs-id>
Writes rcf/define/backstop.json { fromBuildOrder, adoptedAt, adoptedBy }. A tree with no backstop.json has the backstop off (grandfathered by absence). Exit 0 written, 2 usage, 3 unknown FBS.

interfaces.name: VerifyReport
interfaces.description:
The Test-stage verify report.
fields: reportVersion (1), fbsId, headSha, target { kind: url | package, url, packageRef, engine, port, servedSha }, mode, hand, verifierId, startedAt, finishedAt, rcfLiteVersion, verdict, verdictAuthority, runStats { counts { verified, failed, skipped, total } }, perAc [ { acId, result: pass | fail | skipped | critiqueOnly | critiqued, probe, evidence } ]
notes: rcf-lite-local; hand is one of the five estate hands and must be verifier for Finalise to ingest it. A loopback url target must carry engine (free text, the dev server), port (integer) and servedSha (equal to headSha, the committed HEAD served) for Finalise to ingest it (ADR-4151); a package target carries servedSha HEAD (FBS-226).

interfaces.name: rcf/verify-reports/<fbs-id>/<headSha12>.json
interfaces.description:
format: JSON, one VerifyReport v1 per file, UTF-8, two-space indent, trailing newline.
Committed by the verifier hand on the PR branch under a Hand: verifier trailer. Walker-invisible; the separation check classes the directory as verifier evidence, not production code, tests or criteria.

interfaces.name: rcf guidance build-cycle
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf guidance build-cycle
Prints the five-stage contract: Define (test-author), Build (builder), Review (reviewer), Test (verifier, rcf verify run and the committed report, a loopback target naming its engine, port and served sha), Finalise (stage-keeper, CI green on the PR head, rcf build mark complete and rcf build finalise ingesting the report on the PR branch before the merge, then the merge carrying verified). Exit 0.

interfaces.name: managed agent-instructions block
interfaces.description:
format: markdown between the rcf doctor managed markers, hashed in agent-instructions-block.hash.
guidance/managed/agent-instructions-block.md and its hash: the rcf doctor managed CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md block. Changes with this train; the release carries a non-null minAgentAction.

notes: Supersedes the spawn path that 0.3.0 PR 50 introduced and 0.33.0, 0.34.0 and 0.34.1 extended. The ship-authority (0.4.0), per-AC refusal (0.7.0, 0.8.0, 0.20.0, 0.28.0) and per-FBS scope (0.34.0) semantics are kept, read from the ingested report instead of a spawned run.
name: Test-stage verify report, administrative Finalise ingest and the verified backstop
